title: One departmental examination profile
description: PUBLIC syllabus structure over PUBLIC law, and nothing else. A profile records which papers an examination has, what each is worth, and which of the rule books this app already ships each syllabus head maps on to — read off a public recruitment rule or examination notification, cited in `patternSource`. It carries NO question paper, no departmental manual, no internally circulated material and nothing about any organisation's operations. A syllabus head that cannot be mapped to an act in `data/rules` is recorded as `{ "external": true }` — named, weighted, and left empty, so the readiness figure counts it against the reader rather than pretending it does not exist. Weights are NOT in any notification: a notification gives a paper's marks, not a topic's, so `weight` is this app's own apportionment and every surface says so.

examType.description: `ldce` is a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination — a selection, not a qualification. `departmental-promotion` is an examination a promotion is conditional on; `confirmation` is one probation is conditional on; `other` is anything else. The three differ in what a reader is preparing FOR, which is why the plan and the readiness screen say which.

eligibilityNote.description: Who may sit, in the notification's own terms, plus anything about the examination the papers below cannot carry (a shorthand test, an evaluation of record of service). Never advice about a particular reader.

patternSource.description: The public notification or recruitment rule the pattern is read from. `fetchedAt` is present only where this repository actually retrieved the document; a profile compiled without one carries `verify: true` and a row in docs/DATA-GAPS.md.

weightBasis.description: How the per-unit weights below were arrived at, stated in both languages and rendered on the profile. Required, because a weight is the one number here that no notification supplies.

verify.description: True where the pattern could not be read from a document this repository fetched. The banner is shown either way; this decides whether the profile also carries the marigold 'verify' treatment every other unconfirmed record in this app carries.

bilingual.description: Both languages present and non-empty. Equal bilingual footing is a hard rule of this project: a missing Hindi string is a CI failure, never a fallback.

objective.description: True for a multiple-choice paper. The weighted mock builder draws ONLY from objective papers — a noting-and-drafting paper has no key a generated test could mark — and the mock screen says which papers it skipped and why.

negativeMarking.description: The fraction of a question's marks deducted for a wrong answer, e.g. 0.3333 for the one-third the UPSC notification prescribes. Absent means none. A blank answer is never penalised, which is the rule every notification states and `src/lib/exam/mock.ts` implements.

qualifyingMarks.description: Present only where the notification FIXES a figure. Where it reserves the right to fix one at the Commission's discretion, this is absent rather than guessed.

weight.description: Share of its own paper, 0-1. The units of one paper sum to 1. This app's apportionment, never a notification's — see `weightBasis`.

coverage.description: Either a list of pointers into data/rules, or the single object `{ "external": true }` for a syllabus head this app holds nothing for. Never both, and never an empty list — a unit that maps to nothing is external, and saying so is the point.

note.description: What the reader should study instead, and where. Rendered as 'self-study, outside this app'.

coverageRef.description: An act id in data/rules/index.json, optionally narrowed to particular rule ids in data/rules/text/<act>.json. `tests/exam-data.test.ts` resolves every one of these against the committed corpus, in both directions.
